name: Jakub Michálek
detail: Piráti MP and parliamentary club chair; advocated taxing capital gains on sales of companies/stocks over 40m CZK and windfall profits, but explicitly not a recurring net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: KSČM (Komunistická strana Čech a Moravy)
detail: KSČM tax proposals focus on progressive personal income tax (surtax of 40% on incomes over 1 million CZK/year) and asset disclosure registers, not an annual net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Zdeněk Hřib
detail: Chair of Piráti and former Mayor of Prague. Endorses vacant apartment property taxes (daň z prázdného bytu), mineral extraction royalties, and corporate windfall profits taxation, but not an annual net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Tomáš Tožička
detail: Tax Justice Network Czech coordinator and Social Watch ČR chair. Focuses on illicit financial flows, corporate tax havens, financial transactions, and tax evasion, without endorsing a domestic recurring net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Filip Pertold
detail: Economist at CERGE-EI / IDEA think tank. Publicly critiques net wealth taxation citing international capital mobility and valuation issues, recommending personal income tax bracket progression and closing exemptions instead. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Petr Janský
detail: Professor of Economics at Charles University and leader of Centrum veřejných financí (Chytřejší daně). In research and 17 policy recommendations, uses majetkové daně strictly to refer to real estate property tax (daň z nemovitých věcí) and inheritance/transfer taxes rather than net wealth taxation. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Kateřina Konečná
detail: Leader of KSČM and Stačilo! coalition. Platform advocates progressive personal and corporate income taxes, sectoral bank taxes, and vacant apartment taxes, but does not propose a net wealth tax on total personal net assets. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Danuše Nerudová
detail: Economist and MEP (STAN). Frequently advocates raising the real estate property tax (daň z nemovitých věcí) up to OECD averages to rebalance the tax mix away from labor, but does not support an annual net wealth tax. Excluded under Ground Rule 1.

name: Vít Samek
detail: Long-time Vice-President and chief legal expert of ČMKOS. Regularly advocated for taxing wealth and capital on television debates, but passed away in January 2025. Excluded under Ground Rule 2 (living figures only).
